collateralParameters.note: LLTV verified from exact chain engine idToMarketParams; no additional shutdown ratio inferred.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Morpho liquidate reads this market IOracle.price and rejects healthy positions; an incentivized liquidator repays debt for seized collateral. No timelocked liquidation or guaranteed keeper execution is established.

branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When borrower collateral reaches zero, the verified Ethereum Morpho implementation subtracts residual debt from totalSupplyAssets; VaultV2 realizes lending-position losses in NAV. Chain-local Morpho API identity does not prove byte-identical Robinhood runtime.
